headline: FIRST CASH. Ryan rosengren showed Monday and closed on the call: EUR 5,000 collected. The month is off zero, 5,000 of 30,000.

sections.title: Do today
sections.text: Log the EUR 5,000 into the Payments tab dated the day it landed, the cash systems and Rhys's EUR 375 commission read from there. Fix rahul's row: Date Closed says Aug 17 but Closed is unticked with no value, make it say one thing. Confirm Robert Gutierrez for tomorrow and Evan for the 20th. Tag the weekend replies, JJ Macneil and Mr M trades.

sections.title: Watch
sections.text: Cash: EUR 5,000 of 30,000 with 13 days left, and two calls queued this week. Close rate now 2 of 4 shown, sample still under the 5 show gate. Volume is the drag: 35 initials Monday, day five of main account only, one third of the 105 plan.
